content: This medication should not be used in combination with other drugs that may harm the kidneys, such as aminoglycosides (e.g., tobramycin), amphotericin B, foscarnet, pentamidine, vancomycin, or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) like ibuprofen or naproxen, within seven days before and during treatment. Serious, potentially fatal kidney damage may occur. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While using this medication, regular laboratory and medical tests, such as eye exams, are necessary to monitor your condition and prevent complications. To reduce the risk of spreading HIV to others, use effective barrier methods, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during sexual activity. If you miss a dose of this medication, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one. If you miss a dose of probenecid, inform your doctor or pharmacist right away. Store this medication as directed by the product instructions or your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This medication is administered by slow intravenous injection over one hour, typically every one to two weeks, as directed by your doctor. It should not be injected into the eyes. The dosage is determined based on your medical condition, body weight, and response to treatment. Intravenous fluids are usually given before the dose, and probenecid is taken orally before and after administration to protect the kidneys. Drink plenty of fluids unless otherwise directed by your doctor. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. Do not use the medication if either is present. Probenecid must be taken exactly as prescribed. To minimize nausea and vomiting caused by probenecid, take it after meals. This medication works best when used consistently as directed. Do not alter the dosage or discontinue use without consulting your doctor, even for a short period. Avoid direct contact of this medication with your skin, eyes, or mouth. If contact occurs, wash thoroughly with soap and water. Common side effects include nausea, headache, and vomiting, particularly with probenecid use. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare but possible. If you experience any unusual symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other antivirals (e.g., ganciclovir), probenecid, sulfa drugs (e.g., sulfamethoxazole), or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may cause vision changes. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring clear vision until you are certain you can do so safely. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when absolutely necessary, as it may harm an unborn baby. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor. The manufacturer advises avoiding pregnancy during treatment. Men with female partners should use effective barrier protection (e.g., latex or polyurethane condoms) during treatment and for at least 90 days after stopping the medication. It is unknown if this medication passes into breast milk. If you have HIV, breastfeeding may transmit the virus to your baby. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of this medication or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and nonprescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Avoid taking other medications that may harm the kidneys during treatment. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
